description: NixOS fleet flake — dendritic layers, clan-core, impermanence, AI agent fleet

states.in-progress: Being actively worked; not yet verified.
states.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
states.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.name: Phase 1: Nix Build/Eval Coordination & Preflight Locks
features.behavior: Implement nfp-check flock coordinator, optimize init.sh single-pass evaluation, remove build-cores alias, create nix-resource-safety rule, and redact credentials.

evidence.output: nfp-check lock coordination verified with flock; init.sh single-pass evaluation verified; build-cores alias removed; rules updated.

features.name: Phase 2: MCP Correctness and Containment
features.behavior: Remove invalid mcp-gateway systemd unit and port 8085 collision, remove @latest and unpinned npx entries from production MCP catalogs, reconcile ContextForge port 8094 & remove public firewall opening, and add mcp-containment-check.

evidence.output: mcp-containment-check passed; mcp-gateway unit removed; port 8085 uniquely reserved for Hermes; ContextForge firewall opening removed; fleet evaluated cleanly.

features.name: Phase 3: Typed MCP Server Registry & Submodule
features.behavior: Replace attrsOf anything with typed submodule schema (transport, package, command, url, args, environmentFile, scope, domain, risk, approval, dataClasses, maxResultBytes, cacheTtlSeconds, description) and build-time assertions in server-catalog.nix.

evidence.output: mcp-registry-type-check & mcp-containment-check passed; typed submodule schema enforced; build-time assertions for transport, destructive approvals, and remote Tailnet IPs verified.

features.name: Phase 4: MCP-NixOS Authority & Gemini/Antigravity Hardening
features.behavior: Enforce mandatory MCP-NixOS lookup sequence in nix-authority.md rule; configure Antigravity and Gemini CLI harnesses to connect to stdio mcp-nixos store executable and consume AGENTS.md context; add mcp-nixos-authority-check static test.

evidence.output: mcp-nixos-authority-check passed; nix-authority.md created; Antigravity and Gemini CLI generated configs contain mcp-nixos stdio path in Nix store and AGENTS.md contextFiles; single-pass fleet evaluation passed.

features.name: Phase 5: Executor Pilot on Luffy & Control-Plane Hardening
features.behavior: Piloted Agent Executor (AX) integration gateway on luffy as systemd service bound to Tailnet with systemd hardening and options declared under layers.layer-76.orchestrators.executor; added executor-pilot-check static test.

evidence.output: executor-pilot-check passed; executor.nix created with systemd service and option path layers.layer-76.orchestrators.executor; enabled in agent-orchestrator and ai-agent profiles on luffy; single-pass fleet evaluation passed.

features.name: Phase 6: Client Harness Migration & Gateway Routing
features.behavior: Migrate agent client harnesses (Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Kiro CLI, Pi) to connect via mcp-nixos gateway entry point; add mcp-client-migration-check static test.

evidence.output: mcp-client-migration-check passed; verified all client harnesses configure mcp-nixos stdio provider and AGENTS.md context; single-pass fleet evaluation passed.

features.name: Phase 7: Context and Budget Controls
features.behavior: Enforce Headroom context token compression, payload caps (maxResultBytes), and cache TTLs across server catalog and client configs; add mcp-context-budget-check static test.

evidence.output: mcp-context-budget-check passed; headroom registered with budget caps; maxResultBytes and cacheTtlSeconds propagated to client configs; single-pass fleet evaluation passed.
